name: Aditya Birla Lifestyle Brands Ltd
title: Aditya Birla Lifestyle Brands Ltd - 544403 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 revenue +12% to INR 2,174 cr with EBITDA margin 17.2%, but growth is demand-led with capex trimmed to about INR 300 cr and store net adds guided stronger; supply discipline is mixed, not a capital-cycle signal.

capex.quote: there will be some overall reduction in CAPEX, we will continue to be aggressive on CAPEX

triggers.label: Working capital release planned
triggers.quote: we should be able to release some working capital out of that

triggers.label: Capex ~INR 300 cr next year
triggers.quote: About INR 300 crores. So, we will continue with that kind of momentum.

triggers.label: Retail LTL ~7% steady state
triggers.quote: We have projected for the next few years that we should be able to grow at an LTL of about 7%

guidance.quote: INR 250 crores to INR 300 crores is what we have said.
We have projected for the next few years that we should be able to grow at an LTL of about 7%

guidance.value: at least one profitable quarter in FY27
guidance.quote: at least one profitable quarter this year is what we are targeting
dividend broadly in the range of close to 15% to 25% of net profit
we were able to get to a nearly 4% Emerging Business EBITDA. This number should keep improving

red_flags.label: Other-channel jump tied to one-time PLI
red_flags.quote: These are one-time PLI benefits which we have accounted in the financials.

red_flags.label: Evasive answer on other expenses
red_flags.quote: I am not sure where you are reading this.

evasions.quote: I am not sure where you are reading this. If you look at our full year, our margins have expanded.
I think we will have to take it as it comes, because some of this is very fluid right now.
